name: R5_EMERGENCY_UNIVERSAL_VITAL
description: protocol=NCD, but the emergency signal is spo2 < 90, which the fallback engine's universal-emergency check (app/services/triage/fallback.py::_universal_emergency) evaluates BEFORE any protocol-specific rule, for every protocol. This case exists to prove that ordering: if it ever returns MANAGE_HERE, the universal check stopped running first and rule ordering is broken. Illustrative threshold, NOT validated clinical protocol.
